description: We built Wander, a public web tool for the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge. Type any star or coordinates and watch that patch of sky change across every NASA SPHEREx pass, like a flipbook. It catches moving stars like Barnard's Star, shows WISE 0855 glowing in the infrared, and builds spectra and light curves on the fly, all checked against NASA catalogues. We work in Python (Astropy), React and WebGL, and welcome anyone into astronomy, data visualization or design.
